d: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is facing another setback. Yemen's Houthis have managed to hit the tallest tower in Riyadh, which is the office of the Public Investment Fund. This comes just days after a Houthi missile damaged the Aramco building in Riyadh. MBS met with CENTCOM chief Brad Cooper, but the US is yet to commit to fighting the Houthis directly. Firstpost looks at everything that has been going wrong for MBS in 2026.
